definitions.explanation: Telling one thing from another, most often in the negative: can't tell them apart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{双子|ふたご}→双子：03599_futago⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{見分|みわ}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: They're twins, so it's hard to tell them apart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{偽物|にせもの}→偽物：11521_nisemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見分|みわ}け⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had an expert teach me how to tell the real thing from a fake.

notes:
The noun of {見分|みわ}ける (to distinguish, to tell apart).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見分|みわ}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく/つかない: can / can't tell A from B
- {見分|みわ}け⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: how to tell (them) apart

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧: distinction in general, often deliberate (⟦{区別|くべつ}する→区別する：26970_kubetsusuru⟧); {見分|みわ}け stresses recognizing the difference by looking
